description: The shared admin shell scaffold used by all domain skills. Provides the base AdminShell layout, DataTable, StatusBadge, ConfirmDialog, sidebar navigation, and header with user menu. All domain skills (hotel-pms, reservation-booking, restaurant-pos, crm-onboarding) consume this as a shared foundation. Triggers when building any admin dashboard — the layout wrapper that goes around every admin page.
